35mm tight from SOUTHWEST of the bed, looking northeast at his front-right three-quarter mask.

sharply interrupted breaths;
blanket tearing free without damage;
staff and uneven feet;
two doors opening;
urgent overlapping footsteps and restrained alarmed gasps.
